deposit.value: No statutory cap. Itemized return within 30 days after move-out and delivery of possession. If held 6+ months, 5% yearly interest on the part above the greater of $50 or one month's rent.
deposit.evidence: R.C. 5321.16(A)-(B): interest on excess over $50 or one month's rent at 5%; itemized notice within 30 days; no cap stated.

notice.value: 30 days before the periodic rent date for month-to-month; 7 days for week-to-week (R.C. 5321.17).

hoa_law.value: ORC 5312 (planned communities) / 5311 (condos): enforcement charges only after written notice and a hearing if requested; owners may inspect records. Solar devices allowed unless the declaration specifically bans them (5312.16/5311.192), with reasonable HOA limits. Condo flag display protected (5311.191).
hoa_law.evidence: R.C. 5312.11(C)-(D) notice/hearing; 5312.07 records; 5312.16 solar; 5311.191 condo flag display.

permit.value: Yes: annual STR permit from the Building & Zoning Services License Section for dwellings with 5 or fewer guestrooms rented under 30 days; notarized application and fingerprint BCI checks for applicant, host, 24-hour contact and manager; one permit per dwelling.

primary_residence.value: No. Host must be the owner or a 'permanent occupant' (lives there 51%+ of the year); non-resident owners can hold permits. Tenants need written landlord consent to STR use.

zones.value: Ch. 598 has no zone list; a permit does not authorize STR use where other law prohibits it, and the city tells applicants to confirm zoning first.
zones.evidence: C.C.C. 598.04(I); city STR page zoning note. Zoning use tables not read.

caps.value: No numeric cap on permits or nights in Ch. 598; permits can be denied or revoked after 3+ calls for service in 12 months or a nuisance history.
caps.evidence: Full read of Ch. 598; 598.05(B)(9) calls-for-service ground.

max_occupancy.value: No STR-specific guest cap in Ch. 598; an STR is limited to dwellings with 5 or fewer guestrooms; housing-code space limits apply.
max_occupancy.evidence: C.C.C. 598.01(X) five-guestroom limit; no occupancy section in chapter.

hostel_shared.value: Renting part of a dwelling is allowed under the STR permit (whole or in part); more than 5 guestrooms makes it a hotel/motel. STR permits and rooming-house licences are mutually exclusive.

taxes.value: City hotel/motel/STR excise tax totals 5.1% (Ch. 371) on stays under 30 days; county and other lodging taxes not checked.

listing_id.value: Yes: permit number must appear on every platform listing; platforms may not book without it; permit displayed in the unit; host and platform keep records 4 years.

pending.value: Zone In: the new 2024 Zoning Code (Title 34) was adopted July 2024 and applies in phases to rezoned parcels; parcels not yet rezoned stay under Title 33.

registration.value: Yes: city Registry of Residential Rental Properties (Ch. 4515, Ord. 0923-2026, Apr 2026): annual registration naming a local operator within 100 miles, fees and education inspections; STRs and rooming houses exempt. County auditor filing (R.C. 5323) also applies.

family.value: No 'family' definition with an unrelated-person cap in Title 33. Six or more unrelated people sharing a unit is a 'shared living facility' (licensed like a rooming house); renting sleeping rooms to 3+ persons is a rooming house.
family.evidence: C.C.C. 3303 definitions: shared living facility; rooming house; no family entry.

rooming.value: Rooming house = residential building renting sleeping accommodations to 3+ persons; licensed under Housing Code Ch. 4561; cannot also hold an STR permit.
rooming.evidence: C.C.C. 3303 rooming house; 598.03(J); Ch. 4561 exists (not read). District rules not read.

coliving.value: 6+ unrelated people living as one housekeeping unit = 'shared living facility', regulated as a rooming house for licensing.

per_bedroom.value: Sleeping room: at least 70 sq ft for one person, 50 sq ft per person when shared; a dwelling-wide occupancy-area table also applies.

adu.value: Title 33 defines ADUs (separate entrance, subordinate to main dwelling) but Ch. 3332 residential districts do not list them as a use. Zone In (Title 34) districts may allow them; not checked.
adu.evidence: C.C.C. 3303 ADU definition; Ch. 3332 use lists searched, no ADU entry.

worship_zoning.value: Religious facilities are a permitted use in the Title 33 residential districts (rural, SR, R-1 to R-4, R-2F). Housing on church land follows normal zoning.
worship_zoning.evidence: C.C.C. Ch. 3332 district permitted-use lists include religious facility.
